Our Eagle Creek is sensible enough not to mess with a good thing, but it does include a few thoughtful improvements to the traditional wear experience: we’ve swapped the sometimes stuffy oxford cloth of old for a tightly woven, sanforized cotton fabric that will retain its shape and size, and we’ve pre-broken the garment with a vigorous sand wash to give it our signature weathered hand. Better yet, with every wash and every wear, the shirt builds character. Like your favorite jeans. This is one looker that’ll always be a pleasure to wear, and is guaranteed to never go out of style.
